name: Haunted (d20pfsrd)
body:
You are unable to prevent the occurrence of strange noises in your vicinity.

Prerequisite: Ability to cast spells

Effect: -4 on all Listen and Move Silently checks when you are awake/conscious. You cannot control these sounds.

Source not confirmed for this entry. If this is your work, use the Feedback link below to let us know so we can credit it properly.
